sections.title: Audio Converter Workbench
sections.subtitle: Universal high-fidelity audio transcoding engine powered by FFmpeg.

sections.title: System Toolchain Status
sections.details: FFmpeg Universal Audio Processing Engine [Detected / Available]. Audio transcoding pipeline ready.

sections.title: Transcoding Queue (Job List)
sections.details: Right-click any song in your library and select 'Add to Convert Queue' to populate this queue. Tracks will be transcoded in sequence according to the selected parameters below.

sections.title: Target Audio Format
sections.details: Select the target audio encoding container format.

sections.title: Audio Resampling Rate
sections.details: Select the output audio sampling frequency.

sections.title: Encoding Quality & Bit Depth
sections.details: Target encoding bitrate or PCM bit depth (applies to applicable formats).

sections.title: Export Destination Directory
sections.details: Select destination location for transcoded audio files.

sections.title: Start Transcoding (Batch Execution)
sections.details: Action: Click to start processing all tracks in the transcode queue. Non-blocking asynchronous task execution with live progress reporting and host Toast feedback upon completion.
